purpose: Attack Policy Lab's evidence-to-authority semantics without changing the generic Gauntlet dimensions or treating self-authored tests as external validation.
claim_boundary: PASS means the declared machine invariant was reproduced by the reference implementation on the tested revision.
DOCUMENTED means a comparison or limitation is source-backed but not itself an executable proof.
OPEN means the evidence does not yet exist and must not be promoted by copywriting or internal simulation.
Controlled cases do not become empirical validation merely because they pass this suite.
External reproduction, source-holder review, adoption, and pilots remain external evidence classes.

reference_case.boundary: Controlled mechanism case only; empirical_claim remains false.

challenges.title: Evidence capability non-promotion
challenges.question: Can source assurance capabilities be upgraded while retaining the stale evidence identity?
challenges.pass_condition: Capability tampering causes evidence-hash verification to fail.

challenges.title: Policy identity integrity
challenges.question: Does changing policy while holding evidence fixed create a distinct policy and decision identity?
challenges.pass_condition: Evidence hashes remain fixed while policy manifest hash and decision identity change.

challenges.title: Quantity inflation resistance
challenges.question: Can a caller request more quantity than the DecisionResult authorized?
challenges.pass_condition: Decision-bound claim quantity remains equal to the admitted maximum despite an oversized caller value.

challenges.title: Settlement separation
challenges.question: Can settlement assumptions retroactively alter admission or decision identity?
challenges.pass_condition: One decision produces SETTLED, PARTIAL, and SHORTFALL outcomes under different declared settlement capacities without changing its decision identity.

challenges.title: Counterfactual isolation
challenges.question: Does an assurance counterfactual mutate the observed evidence?
challenges.pass_condition: The evidence identity remains unchanged; only declared provenance context and resulting policy consequence change.

challenges.title: Policy sensitivity disclosure
challenges.question: Are score-material policy thresholds exposed as assumptions rather than disguised as empirical estimates?
challenges.pass_condition: Declared sensitivity variants change only the intended policy parameter and produce an ordered, attributable quantity response.

challenges.title: Semantic ambiguity fail-closed
challenges.question: Does malformed or semantically incomplete evidence fail clearly rather than receive invented assumptions?
challenges.pass_condition: Relevant constraint-core conformance tests pass; no new external-validation credit is awarded.

challenges.title: Lifecycle anti-reuse, cancellation, and correction
challenges.question: Can duplicate/overlapping evidentiary use, cancellation, and correction lineage be proven end-to-end?
challenges.pass_condition: C3 lifecycle corpus passes with deterministic duplicate/overlap refusal and correction lineage.
challenges.gap: The current evaluation inventory marks anti-reuse and revision lineage incomplete/planned.

challenges.title: Independent clean-room reproduction
challenges.question: Can a person who did not build Policy Lab reproduce the frozen result without coaching?
challenges.pass_condition: A named external evaluator records environment, duration, interventions, and matching decision/package identities.

challenges.title: Release provenance
challenges.question: Is the judge-facing release cryptographically bound to its source revision and build?
challenges.pass_condition: Frozen release has source SHA, artifact digest, SBOM/attestation where available, screenshot manifest, and reproducible build record.

challenges.title: External-source heterogeneity
challenges.question: Does the mechanism survive a materially different owner/operator, institutional, API, or registry source?
challenges.pass_condition: At least one additional attributable external case closes its declared source/review contract.

challenges.title: Independent evaluator comprehension
challenges.question: Can uncoached evaluators correctly distinguish evidence, admission, quantity, and settlement?
challenges.pass_condition: Blind comprehension protocol records questions, responses, scoring rule, and results without treating liking the demo as validation.

challenges.title: Standards and adjacent-system differentiation
challenges.question: Is the contribution distinguishable from generic policy engines, authorization languages, verifiable credentials, proof-of-reserve feeds, and financial-contract standards?
challenges.pass_condition: Source-backed matrix states overlap, non-overlap, and prohibited novelty claims.

challenges.title: Practical workflow validation
challenges.question: Does an outside user or institution have a real workflow/problem for which this mechanism is useful?
challenges.pass_condition: Inspectable interviews, integration request, pilot, or repeated use exists; internal route simulation does not count.
